s.h: About The Role And Potential Progression
s.t:
__Für wen dieser Job nicht ist__Bevor du weiterliest, kurz und ehrlich:
Wenn du Aktivität mit Ergebnis verwechselst (viele Calls, wenig Abschluss), wirst du hier nicht glücklich.
Wenn du lieber ein eingespieltes Playbook 1:1 abspulst statt es mitzugestalten, ist das nicht dein Umfeld.
Wenn dir Politik, Status und lange Freigabeschleifen wichtig sind, bist du hier falsch - wir sind knapp 50 Leute und entscheiden schnell.
Wenn du bis hier gelesen hast und denkst "genau mein Ding" - weiter geht's.
Worum es geht
Du übernimmst deine eigene Pipeline mit Fokus auf gehobenen Mittelstand und Enterprise ab 1.000+ Mitarbeitenden , führst Deals eigenständig von Discovery bis Abschluss und baust Kundenbeziehungen auf, die über den ersten Vertrag hinaus tragen. Du bekommst kein fertiges Territory ohne Substanz - unsere Kunden sind Namen wie die Deutsche Bahn, AOK, ADAC und Rossmann, und das Thema (Wissen & KI im Unternehmen) hat gerade enormen Rückenwind.
Du arbeitest eng mit Sebastian (Gründer/CEO) und dem Sales-Leadership zusammen: schnelles Feedback, direkte Wege, keine Umwege über drei Ebenen. Das Sales-Team ist mit aktuell 4 Leuten bewusst schlank - du bist keine Nummer in einem großen Vertriebsapparat, sondern siehst direkt, was dein Beitrag bewirkt.
Deine ersten 90 Tage
Woche 1: Onboarding in Produkt, ICP, Buying-Center-Logik, CRM/Framework + Shadowing bei Discovery Calls und Demos
Ab Woche 2: Erste eigene Discovery Calls + Demos, parallel weiteres Shadowing bei Enterprise-Demos
Ab Woche 2/3: Aufbau deiner eigenen Pipeline - du wartest nicht, bis "alles sitzt"
Ab Monat 3: Erste eigene, kleinere Deals bis zum Proof of Value
What's in it for you
Vergütung: OTE 90.000-130.000 € , je nach Skillset und Seniorität. Der Split zwischen Fix und Bonus liegt flexibel zwischen 50:50 und 70:30 – je nachdem, was zu dir passt. Der Bonus ist uncapped und quartalsweise ausgezahlt.
Entwicklungsweg: Konkrete Perspektive auf Senior AE (größere Accounts, höhere Ticketgrößen), Key Account Manager oder Lead-Rolle (Coaching, Teilsegment-Ownership)
Direkter Zugang zur Führung: Kurze Wege zu dem Leadership-Team, schnelles Feedback
Stabilität ohne Investorendruck: Wir sind profitabel, bootstrapped, wachsen aus eigener Kraft - keine kurzfristige Exit-Logik
Namhafte Referenzen: Deutsche Bahn, AOK, ADAC, Rossmann und weitere - du verkaufst mit Substanz, nicht mit Versprechen
AI-first ab Tag 1: Wir haben Claude für das ganze Team ausgerollt und setzen es aktiv im Arbeitsalltag ein
Choose your own device: Windows oder Mac - deine Entscheidung
Arbeitsmodus: Hybrides Modell mit 2–3 Tagen Onsite im Office Frankfurt, restliche Tage flexibel im Home Office
How you can make an impact
Pipeline aufbauen: Zielkunden identifizieren, qualifizieren, Dealflow über mehrere Kanäle selbst treiben
Enterprise-Discovery führen: Buying Center verstehen, Pain Points rund um Wissen, Enablement und Produktivität herausarbeiten
Deals strukturiert steuern: Vom Erstkontakt über Demo, Business Case, Proof of Value bis zur Verhandlung - mit MEDDIC als Werkzeug, nicht als Pflichtübung
ROI-Sprache statt Feature-Pitch: Mehrwert auf Business-Ebene argumentieren (Effizienz, Risiko, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit)
Feedback an Product & Marketing zurückspielen: Du schärfst aktiv mit an ICP, Messaging und Go-to-Market
Nach außen sichtbar sein: Ausgewählte Events, Messen, digitale Formate
Daten- statt Bauchgefühl-Vertrieb: Du pflegst dein HubSpot-CRM aktiv und nutzt es als echten Hebel - für saubere Forecasts, klare Priorisierung und Deals, die auf Fakten basieren
Skills to be successful

Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise Enterprise oder komplexe Buying-Center
Eigenständig Deals von A–Z begleitet und abgeschlossen - mit nachweisbaren Ergebnissen
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Erfahrung mit strukturierten Sales-Frameworks (MEDDIC, Challenger, SPICED) - wenn nicht vorhanden, entwickeln wir das mit dir
Erfahrung im C-Level-/Bereichsleiter-Umfeld

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse, statt Gründe zu suchen, warum es nicht geklappt hat
Du willst in den nächsten 12-18 Monaten eine steile Lernkurve und bist bereit die Extrameile zu gehen
Klare Worte sind dir wichtiger als diplomatischer Nebel - auch uns gegenüber
Du greifst aktiv zu KI-Tools und baust dir eigene Automatisierungen, die deinen Alltag schneller machen
Your path to Omnora

About WorkWhile
WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. 83 million Americans work hourly jobs: the true backbone of the hospitality, catering, and event industries. These workers often face highly volatile schedules, sudden booking surges, minimum wage pay, and limited benefits, leading to financial instability.
WorkWhile identifies the best, most reliable hourly workers and matches them with shifts that fit their skills, location, and life.

For high-volume catering companies, stadium and venue operators, corporate food service providers, and large-scale event producers, we provide instant access to a vetted, high-quality workforce to seamlessly scale up for major events and peak periods.

For workers, we provide stable income and unmatched benefits, including next-day pay, free telehealth services, upskilling, and financial wellness tools.
We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work in hospitality and live events.

WorkWhile is looking for an Enterprise Account Manager - Hospitality to join our team and build long-term, trusting relationships with our enterprise hospitality and event clients.

This role is focused on managing a portfolio of high-volume accounts, including catering conglomerates, national contract food service providers, sports and entertainment venue operators, and premier event management groups, ensuring they have the right workforce to keep operations running smoothly, especially during peak seasons, major event rollouts, and sudden booking surges.
You will serve as the primary point of contact for hospitality enterprise accounts, driving satisfaction, retention, and growth while acting as a strategic partner who understands the fast-paced, high-stakes nature of food service, catering, and venue management.

Lead Account Relationship: Serve as the lead point of contact for all account management matters for enterprise hospitality and event clients, including staffing planning, shift fulfillment, and ongoing labor strategy.
Build Executive & Regional Alignment: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with regional event/culinary directors, general managers, corporate food service directors, venue concessionaires, and VP-level operations leaders.
Understand Industry Dynamics: Develop a deep understanding of each client’s operational environment, including hyper-seasonal staffing volatility, last-minute event bookings/cancellations, variable labor costs, and guest service standards, to proactively meet their workforce needs.
Drive Contract Growth & Retention: Maintain and grow client accounts, identifying upsell and expansion opportunities across regional event sites, venue networks, multi-unit properties, or new culinary/hospitality labor categories.
Act as a Trusted Advisor: Develop trusted advisor relationships with key hospitality accounts, aligning WorkWhile's workforce solutions to their operational goals, ROI targets, and guest experience standards.
Ensure Operational Excellence: Ensure timely and successful fulfillment of shifts in line with strict client SLAs, worker reliability metrics, and service quality expectations for high-profile events.
Transparent Stakeholder Communication: Communicate the progress of weekly, monthly, and quarterly workforce initiatives clearly to both internal operations teams and enterprise client executives.
Track & Forecast Metrics: Forecast and track key account metrics including fill rates, worker attendance/performance, client satisfaction scores, and revenue retention and expansion.
Deliver Business Reviews: Prepare regular account health reports and quarterly business reviews tailored to venue operators, contract food service executives, and catering leadership teams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Sales team to expand WorkWhile's presence across new venue networks or regional operator groups, and collaborate with internal Operations teams to ensure fulfillment during peak periods (e.g., stadium game days, peak catering seasons, major conferences).
Issue Escalation & Resolution: Assist with challenging client requests or live-event operational escalations, providing quick and effective resolutions to minimize disruption to the guest experience.

Experience: 3+ years experience as an Account Manager, ideally within the contract food service, event management, catering, venue operations, or flexible workforce solutions industries.
Deep Hospitality & Event IQ: A profound understanding of the logistics behind large-scale catering, stadium operations, corporate dining, and how workforce reliability directly impacts guest experience and margin.
Executive Presence & Influence: Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence stakeholders at all levels, from regional culinary directors and venue GMs to VP-level hospitality executives.
Multi-Unit Expertise: Experience managing multi-unit, enterprise-scale hospitality accounts, venue networks, or multi-city event portfolios.
Tech Stack Proficiency: Solid experience with CRM software (Salesforce or similar) and Google Suite.
Track Record of Growth: Proven track record of delivering client-focused labor solutions, maintaining high customer retention rates, and hitting revenue growth/expansion targets.
Agility & Attention to Detail: Ability to juggle multiple complex enterprise accounts and fast-moving event timelines while maintaining sharp attention to detail.
Communication Skills: Excellent listening, negotiation, presentation, verbal, and written communication skills.

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.
This is a remote position, open to candidates based in Mexico.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements.

For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements.

Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.

We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Sales team, a cornerstone of DeepL's market expansion and customer engagement strategy.
Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing sales teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and commitment to excellence. As a member of our Sales team, you will play a central role in growing our business and expanding our global reach into new markets. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to deliver tailored solutions that genuinely meet our clients' needs.
About this opportunity
We are looking for an exceptional sales professional based in Austria (preferable) OR Switzerland to establish and grow DeepL's presence in the Austrian market. This is a rare opportunity to build something meaningful in a market where we're just getting started.

You will be a key player in our Austrian expansion, bringing together an entrepreneurial approach with deep market knowledge — and you won't be doing it alone. You'll have the full support of an experienced, collaborative international team behind you.

Shape our Austrian market entry: You will be at the forefront of DeepL's expansion into Austria, introducing our market-leading translation services to clients and helping them break down language barriers
Build with purpose: Establish our sales foundation in Austria — creating processes, relationships, and market presence where little currently exists
Become a trusted market expert: Develop deep knowledge of the Austrian business landscape, cultural nuances, and customer needs to position DeepL as a valued and trusted solution
Represent and advocate: Serve as an expert on DeepL's products and your customers' needs, troubleshooting thoughtfully and resolving inquiries with care
Own the full sales cycle: As a trusted partner to new and incoming customers, you will qualify and convert leads and guide opportunities from first contact to close
Set and reach meaningful goals: Work towards monthly activity, pipeline, and revenue goals as we establish our presence in the market together
Cultivate a strong pipeline: Identify and develop new business opportunities, including upselling and cross-selling where it adds real value for clients
Manage diverse opportunities: Respond to inbound prospects and customers, navigating a varied mix of opportunities from qualification through to close
Stay organised and forward-looking: Track opportunity and customer details including use cases, timelines, and next steps to keep things moving smoothly
Connect across teams: Work closely with our diverse, international, and welcoming teams — from SDRs to Marketing — collaborating across borders with openness and curiosity
Qualities we look for
We know that confidence gaps and imposter syndrome can sometimes hold people back from applying. If you're excited about this role and feel you have most of what we're looking for, we'd genuinely love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box.
Entrepreneurial mindset: You enjoy building from the ground up and feel energised by the challenge of creating something new. You're comfortable with ambiguity and motivated by the opportunity to make a real impact
Deep Austrian market knowledge: You have genuine knowledge and appreciation of Austrian business culture, market dynamics, and customer preferences — and you understand what makes the market unique
Cultural fluency: You connect authentically with Austrian clients and partners, and bring a genuine appreciation for local values and business practices
Solid full-cycle sales experience: A proven track record in Enterprise Sales with the ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals
SaaS expertise: Experience in software sales — especially SaaS — is preferred
Strong communication skills: Excellent organisation, presentation, and communication skills (verbal and written) across multicultural contexts
Adaptability and resilience: You feel comfortable in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment and can shift priorities while maintaining momentum
Collaborative spirit: You thrive when working as part of a team, enjoy supporting colleagues, and value cross-functional collaboration
Language proficiency: Fluent in both, German and English

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Remote work, flexible hours : we offer a remote work schedule for Austria , enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

Who We Are
Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription .

We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!
Your Team and Role
As a Senior Business Development Manager on the Partnerships team, you’ll lead DuckDuckGo’s most complex Product partnerships and drive strategy — sourcing, negotiating, and scaling high-impact deals with partners that can materially enhance our entire portfolio of products (search, Duck.ai, Privacy Pro subscriptions, etc) and work on related projects.

Many of these partnerships will be the first-of-their-kind where you will have to create playbooks from 0-to-1 — you'll be structuring deals where the product, economics, and strategic value need to be figured out together, and you’ll be working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Finance to make them real.
You'll manage a portfolio of competing and complementary partner relationships, forging partnerships with leading organizations while, in the case of AI, navigating the strategic tradeoffs of a market where pricing, capabilities, and competitive dynamics shift quarterly. Your work will directly shape how our products evolve, including Duck.ai and Assist, and reach millions of users.
What Projects Might Look Like
Figuring out further partnerships that could enhance our Duck.ai and Search Assist offerings
Identifying opportunities for Partnerships to drive product enhancement and user engagement/retention.
Creating new distribution channels to help grow our AI related services

10+ years of Business Development, Partnerships, or Strategic Partnerships experience.
2+ years of cross-functional leadership on partnership projects and teams, including legal and engineering.
Experience with consumer internet or user-facing software business with an understanding of the AI/LLM ecosystem and how AI capabilities are being integrated into consumer products.
Significant experience leading complex product partnerships end-to-end — from identifying the opportunity through deal close and beyond. These should be partnerships where you've created something new together and navigated real product and technical complexity, not sales deals or API licensing.
Self-sufficiency on the commercial details — you don’t wait for someone else to draft terms, build financial models, or pressure-test deal structures — you can handle these details on your own while partnering with Legal and Finance.
Experience managing a portfolio of complex strategic partner relationships and an understanding of the tradeoffs that come with balancing competing and complementary providers.
You build trust quickly with internal teams, partners, and stakeholders you've never worked with before. You're collaborative by default and decisive when it counts.
Located in US or Canada.

$200,267 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.
Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.
Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.
Hiring Process
Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire .
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants , and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.
We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.

You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing
Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.
While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.
A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.
By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.
Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process
As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy . We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.
Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.
Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

About SINGU
At SINGU , we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.
Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide , supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.
Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.
If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.
The Opportunity
This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.
The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case, not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance.
Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition.
Why Strong Sellers Join Singu
A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch.
Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential.
Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship.
Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee.
Uncapped earnings with meaningful accelerators for over-performance.
Credible routes into strategic or global accounts or sales leadership.
What You Will Own
Pipeline and Coverage
A new business quota, and a territory plan that shows how you intend to hit it.
Pipeline built through business development, marketing, partner and self-generated activity, with personal responsibility for coverage across the territory.
Diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance and risk.
Deal Execution
Opportunities qualified to a MEDDICC standard, with a quantified business case and access to the economic buyer.
Every material deal multi-threaded, so it survives a change of sponsor.
Commercial negotiation that builds value and protects price rather than defaulting to discount.
Rigorous qualification and early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process or route to decision.
Land and Expand
First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start.
A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented.
Forecasting and Governance
A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind.
Risk surfaced early, with an honest view of what changed and what is needed.
Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases.
What Excellent Performance Looks Like
Commercial outcomes
New-logo ARR against quota
Pipeline creation and territory coverage
Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision
Average deal value and total multi-year value
Strategic logos won
Operating standards
Forecast accuracy and stage integrity
Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality
Price protection and discount discipline
CRM quality and process discipline
Your First 12 Months
First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities.
By six months: credible coverage against ramped quota, multi-threaded opportunities progressing through evaluation, and a first customer win closed or materially advanced.
By 12 months: delivery against ramped quota, a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and accounts landed with clear expansion potential.

Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota. Quality of results matters more than years.
Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created and representative deals won. We will ask for specifics.
The ability to take us through significant deals end to end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.
English and German languages at business level. Hard requirement.
A structured seller: MEDDICC or comparable, used in practice.
Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline to run a predictable business.
CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech or multi-site operations experience is an advantage.
Package, Support and Progression
Competitive base salary uncapped commission, accelerators for over-performance.
Business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing and enablement to support your success
Structured onboarding, methodology training and deal coaching, with a fairly ramped quota.
Progression into a global accounts or sales leadership. We back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.
This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.
If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt for Work is a rapidly-growing B2B business at Wolt, and we have ambitious plans to massively accelerate this growth. Our mission is simple: we want to bring the same great user experience that Wolt is known for to business users around the world.

Through Wolt’s established delivery network and vast number of restaurant and retail partners, Wolt for Work enables businesses to boost their employees’ happiness no matter where they are working, promote camaraderie in teams, and save time and effort running office events.

We are already live in 16 of Wolt’s 23 countries, with no plans to slow down.
What you'll be doing
Full end-to-end responsibility over the sales acquisition funnel, from A-Z within the enterprise market.
Own the full sales cycle for inbound and outbound opportunities, including prospecting, negotiation, and closing partnership agreements across enterprise and SMB customers.
Acting as problem-solver for prospects’ needs and working with internal stakeholders to formulate solutions for them.
Working closely with Account Managers to ensure consistent and optimal outcomes for the business and for clients.
Working with our Marketing team to develop partnerships, attend events and create an acquisition funnel.
Our humble expectations
Experience in sales, account management, business development and/or partnerships in B2B enterprise fields. Startup or Scaleup experience is a plus.
Ambition - lots of it - and strong inner motivation paired with a positive mindset (it's the key to hitting targets)
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to adapt communication to suit the audience.
Structured and analytical problem-solver with a drive for taking action when necessary
Natural tendency for ownership with a get-stuff-done, entrepreneurial attitude
Organized and structured way of working, including working with CRMs.
Tenacity and creativity to approach and solve clients’ problems.
True culture champion who rolls-up-his/her sleeves, exemplifies teamwork, and drives decision-making with data. We also value humbleness and politeness at all times!
Excellent communication and presentation skills in German and English.

High growth, startup, or scaleup experience
Experience with marketplace businesses
Experience in marketing, operations, logistics, or customer success
Proficiency in one or more analytics & visualization tools (e.g. Excel, G Suite, Looker)
Next steps
If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then and get the conversation going!
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Upsell and cross-sell — expansion within your existing customers: more users, adjacent products, new use cases inside the relationships you already hold.

After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving
upmarket.This role is the person who helps build the commercial motion as we shift towards increasingly complex upmarket accounts.

As Manager of Mid-Market Sales for Toast Retail, you will lead a small team of Mid-Market Account Executives pursuing multi-location retail with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not exist at Toast Retail yet. You will build it.
This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a playbook and run it well. There is no Mid-Market Toast Retail playbook. A growing set of proof points from our SMB business, a leadership team that is investing, and a set of open questions that someone has to go answer.

What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner? Which of our SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain?

You will form the hypotheses, run them in the field, and turn what works into something repeatable that the next ten AEs can execute.
Expect to spend real time outside your own team.

Getting this motion off the ground means sitting with Product on inventory and scan data gaps, with Marketing on messaging that lands with a category buyer, with Enablement on training that does not exist yet, with Deal Desk and Finance on structures we have not offered before, and with Onboarding on implementations that are meaningfully harder than a single site install.

Your ability to move those partners without formal authority over any of them will matter as much as your ability to coach a deal.
This is a player coach role in year one. You will carry a number yourself while you hire and build the team, which means you will be closing Mid-Market Retail deals before you are coaching them. That is deliberate. The person who writes this playbook should draw from their own first-hand experiences from running the motion, not just observations of other people running it. As the team scales, your quota shifts to theirs.
You will report to the VP of Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations up to 40 percent of the time.
A day in the life
Carry and deliver an individual quota in year one (player-coach) while you hire, onboard, and ramp your team, transitioning to a full team number as your team scales.
Hire, develop, motivate, and manage a quota achieving Mid-Market sales team from the ground up, setting the bar for talent in a brand new function
Build and codify the Mid-Market Retail sales process: discovery frameworks, demo flows, business case models, mutual action plans, and executive proposals tailored to grocery, liquor, and convenience buyers
Run a disciplined sales process and coach your team on qualification rigor, multithreading, and champion development inside complex retail organizations
Own live Mid-Market deals end to end yourself, then convert what you learn into discovery frameworks, demo flows, business cases, and proposals the team can run
Get in the field. Join discovery calls, sit in on site visits, and walk stores with your reps so the playbook you write is grounded in what actually happens in front of a customer
Own all stages of the sales lifecycle with your team: pipeline generation, executive meetings, value proposition development, deal structuring, negotiation, and close
Partner across Product, Marketing, Enablement, Deal Desk, Finance, and Onboarding to close the gaps that stand between us and a repeatable Mid-Market motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself
Bring the voice of the Mid-Market retailer back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes
Forecast accurately in a business with little historical data, and be honest about what you know versus what you are still learning
Assess and engage in competitive RFPs
Leverage GTM tech stack to run an efficient, AI-anchored motion: establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet, and report on them credibly.
Distinguish repeatable process from one off hero deals, and build only the former into the playbook
Stay close to the competitive landscape across grocery, liquor, and convenience technology, and position Toast Retail sharply against incumbents
What you'll need to thrive
5+ years of sales experience in a sourcing and closing role, with a track record in Mid-Market or complex, multi stakeholder deals
3+ years of sales leadership experience with a proven record of building and developing quota achieving teams and excellence in outbound pipeline generation
Demonstrated expertise in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiation, and closing with new and existing customers
Proficiency with MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, plus disciplined pipeline management and forecasting
A closer who is also a builder. You are recently and personally credible in front of a Mid-Market buyer, and you are not looking for a role where you stop selling
A genuine founder's mindset. You are energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity, and your instinct when a process is missing is to write it rather than ask for it
Exceptional cross functional influence. You have a history of getting Product, Marketing, and Operations partners to move on your priorities without owning them
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to hold the room with executive stakeholders and negotiate complex pricing arrangements
Comfortable educating customers and team members on the fundamentals of US credit card processing
What will help you stand out
Experience standing up a new segment, vertical, or motion inside an existing company, especially taking an SMB product upmarket
Experience selling into or operating within grocery, convenience, liquor, or specialty retail
Fluency in the operational realities of retail: inventory depth and SKU management, scan data, shrink, category management, age verification and compliance, fuel and foodservice
Experience in a fast paced, high growth technology environment
A proven track record of creating a winning culture that performs at a high level
Is this your kind of build?
The best version of this hire is someone who reads a role with this much white space and gets excited rather than nervous, and who wants to close the first ten deals themselves before handing the playbook to a team. If you want to point at a Mid-Market business two years from now and say you built it, we would like to talk.
AI at Toast
At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality.

We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

· Prospecter et développer de nouveaux clients groupes : entreprises, agences, tour-opérateurs, associations, clubs, etc.

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises.

Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion.

Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform.

By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers.

Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
Join Apollo as an Enterprise Account Executive (Founding Team). In this role, you’ll play a critical part in driving growth and guiding sales leaders and operations professionals through their evaluation of Apollo’s powerful, all-in-one sales platform.

Apollo.io is building its foundational team of sellers responsible for taking the company into the enterprise segment. In this full-cycle land, expand, and renew role, you will drive our growth into organizations with 1,000+ employees by acquiring new logos, retaining and renewing existing customers, and expanding accounts across your book of business.
As a founding member of this new segment, you’ll shape our motion, influence strategy, and set the standard for how Apollo wins in larger, more complex environments. This role is ideal for a high-performing seller who wants meaningful ownership, greenfield opportunity, and the ability to directly impact Apollo’s next phase of growth.

New Logo Acquisition
Own a defined set of enterprise accounts (1,000+ employees) as part of Apollo’s first team dedicated to this segment.
Proactively engage Director, VP, and C-suite leaders across Sales, Marketing and RevOps to build qualified pipeline and close new logos.
Partner with the Outbound BDR team to drive incremental pipeline.
Build a repeatable motion for engaging enterprise prospects as Apollo scales upmarket.
Achieve 3X pipeline coverage and exceed new business acquisition targets.
Account Expansion
Mature your understanding of your customers’ business goals to identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
Build account plans that maximize adoption and generate multi-year growth across your accounts.Partner with Customer Success, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers receive high-impact value that drives expansion revenue.Influence Apollo’s upmarket playbook by identifying expansion patterns and informing product and GTM strategy.
Revenue Retention & Renewals
Own renewals across your book of business with strong preparation, forecasting, and value-focused executive conversations.
Identify churn risks early and collaborate cross-functionally to drive adoption and prevent attrition.
Build multi-threaded relationships to ensure account stability and long-term success.
Sales Strategy & Execution
Use a data-driven approach to identify high-potential logo, expansion, and renewal opportunities.
Maintain precise pipeline hygiene and forecast revenue within a 10% accuracy margin.
Contribute to the development of Apollo’s enterprise GTM strategy through real-time insights from customer conversations.
Leverage Apollo’s platform and your outbound expertise to build meaningful relationships and position Apollo as a mission-critical revenue engine.
Mindset & Culture
Bring a “hunter + farmer” mentality - you’re equally strong in outbound acquisition and long-term account growth.
Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where processes, playbooks, and systems are still being built.
Embrace a collaborative, ambitious, and customer-first culture.
Operate with a builder’s mindset: resourceful, solutions-oriented, and motivated by being part of a founding go-to-market team.

7+ years of quota-carrying AE experience, ideally with both new business and expansion ownership in GTM enterprise SaaS.
Consistent track record of exceeding quota across new business, expansions, and renewals.
Experience selling into enterprises (1,000+ employees) and navigating multi-threaded executive-level deals.
Fluency in sales methodologies such as Command of the Message and qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC.
Strong ability to manage the full customer lifecycle from prospecting to renewals, while maintaining a strategic and consultative approach.
High degree of ownership, grit, and adaptability suited for a founding team environment.
Excellent communication, executive presence, negotiation skills, and cross-functional partnership abilities.

Our product-led growth model has attracted a significant number of high-growth companies who have scaled their usage organically, and as they grow, it's critical that we evolve from just a self-service solution into a proactive business partner.

This role is pivotal in demonstrating Render's long-term value and scalability, owning the commercial health of the relationship, and ensuring our customers achieve their business objectives on our platform.
As the primary business owner for a portfolio of Render's most important customers, you will be responsible for understanding their strategic goals, leading commercial conversations, and driving adoption and expansion.

You will proactively identify and mitigate churn risks by reinforcing our value proposition against alternatives managed platform services and hyperscalers.

Working in close partnership with our Customer Engineers, you will provide a holistic experience that combines deep technical guidance, knowledge/best practices sharing and ultimately securing our position as a long-term partner in their success.

Manage a large book of ~300 commercial accounts using a 1-to-many, programmatic engagement model—delivering consistent value at scale through proactive outreach and enablement.
Build and run scalable programs that drive adoption and expansion (e.g., onboarding journeys, product education series, lifecycle campaigns, webinars/office hours, and targeted nurture motions).
Proactively share best practices, playbooks, and technical guidance in partnership with Customer Engineers—helping customers succeed through self-serve resources and repeatable workflows.
Identify and prioritize accounts for targeted, higher-touch interventions using health signals and product usage data; mitigate churn risks through timely education and clear next steps.
Own and execute contracting motions across your book, including renewals, annualization/commit motions, and standard commercial expansion—working closely with Sales, RevOps, and Legal to remove friction.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Support to surface customer insights and influence the programs, content, and product improvements that will most impact scaled customers.
Track and report on program performance (adoption, retention, renewal/commit conversion, expansion) and continuously iterate based on results.
Represent Render with authenticity, curiosity, and technical credibility in every customer interaction.

Has 5+ years of proven experience in a customer-facing role such as Account Management or Customer Success, preferably in the cloud infrastructure or developer tooling space.
Possesses a commercial mindset with a track record of successfully managing renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and negotiating contracts
Is familiar with using product usage data or analytics to identify customer health risks and expansion opportunities.
Is a strategic thinker who can connect the dots between a customer's technical challenges and their overarching business goals.
Excels at building rapport and trust with a wide range of stakeholders from senior engineers to C-level executives.
Is savvy with product-led growth (PLG) environments and understands how to engage customers who initially adopted a product through a self-service motion.
Is a builder who thrives in ambiguity. You are energized by the opportunity to shape a new function and create processes, not frustrated by the lack of standardized playbooks.
Has a strong sense of empathy and a genuine passion for helping developers and engineering teams succeed.

About Nivoda 🚀
Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.
Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

You take a booked demo and turn it into a live, transacting Nivoda customer. That means running a compelling demo of the marketplace, navigating commercial negotiation, closing the contract, shepherding the customer through KYC/onboarding compliance, and owning the account through its first 90 days — first search, first order, first reorder.
This is not a pure "close and toss" role. The first 90 days are where marketplace customers form habits or churn silently, so you are accountable for activation, not just signature. You need to understand how two-sided marketplaces work — liquidity, supply trust, transaction mechanics — and ideally how the jewellery trade buys.
What will you be doing? 😎
Run discovery-led demos that map Nivoda's marketplace to the retailer's actual buying workflow.
Manage the deal: proposal, commercial terms, objection handling, multi-stakeholder buy-in, close.
Drive KYC and compliance to completion without letting momentum die — chase documents, unblock friction.
Own days 0–90: get the customer searching, quoting, and placing first orders; set usage habits early.
Coordinate with SDRs on handoff quality and with AMs on a clean day-90 transition (account context, buying patterns, risks).
Forecast accurately and keep pipeline stages honest.
What do we need from you? 💪
3–6 years closing experience, with background in a marketplace (B2B or transactional B2C — think platforms where you sold liquidity and trust, not just software) or in the jewellery/diamond industry with commercial exposure.
You understand marketplace dynamics: why the first transaction matters more than the contract, how supply breadth wins deals, what makes buyers switch procurement behaviour.
Strong demo craft: you sell workflows and outcomes, not feature tours.
Comfortable with operational follow-through — KYC, onboarding, activation — because signature is the midpoint, not the finish line.
Structured negotiator; calm with pushback on pricing and terms.
Native or professional proficiency in English and German is required for this role.

Virtualitics is seeking a quota-carrying Sales Account Executive to own the Autonomous Maritime ecosystem across the Federal Systems Integrator and Defense Industrial Base market. The successful candidate will execute five coordinated growth motions within strategic accounts: Sell-To, Sell-Through, Sell-With, Embed/OEM, and Foreign Military Sales (FMS). venture-backed maritime robotics, autonomy, sensing, communications, and undersea technology companies

Multi-thread relationships: Build trusted access across executive leadership, business development, capture, program delivery, technical, security, contracts, international, and FMS organizations.
Lead the internal team: Orchestrate solutions engineering, customer success, marketing, product, contracts, capture, executive advisors, and FMS/export specialists around the highest-value opportunities.

7+ years of success in a quota-carrying Federal sales, strategic accounts, channel, alliances, or business-development role.
Demonstrated relationships and revenue experience within the Autonomous Maritime market.
Experience selling enterprise software, AI/ML, data analytics, decision intelligence, or other complex mission technology solutions.
Evidence of net-new hunting, executive access, opportunity creation, multi-stakeholder qualification, negotiation, and closing.
Working knowledge of U.S. federal acquisition and FSI capture, including teaming, NDAs, IRAD, RFIs/RFPs, IDIQs, OTAs, task orders, and partner commercial structures.
Ability to communicate a complex technical and mission value proposition to executives, capture leaders, program teams, operators, and technical audiences.
Willingness to travel 40–50% and operate independently in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.

Track record executing two or more of the five growth motions, with strong preference for candidates who have built sell-through, OEM/embedded, or FMS revenue.
Experience with the FMS ecosystem and stakeholders, including U.S. primes, DSCA, Department of State, implementing agencies, Security Cooperation Organizations, and partner-nation customers.
Understanding of exportability, technology releasability, ITAR/export controls, data sovereignty, cybersecurity, cloud authorization, and classified or controlled mission environments.
Experience with MEDDPICC, Challenger, or another disciplined enterprise-sales methodology.
Active security clearance and bachelor’s degree, or equivalent relevant experience.

First 90 days: Establish ecosystem credibility, build the relationship map, qualify the initial account portfolio, and create a focused pipeline across the five motions.
First year: Convert new partner relationships into direct, program, joint-solution, embedded, and qualified international revenue paths while meeting or exceeding annual quota.

TL;DR: This is not a classic sales role. We have a full pipeline of some of the largest companies in the world, and we're looking for the sharpest enterprise sellers to own those accounts end-to-end, not just the signature. From first conversation to multi-year partnership.
Why Conduct
We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.
Every process change, every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.
We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.
We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.
What you'll own
You own everything between Conduct and the customer, and the commercial outcome with it:
Run the full sales cycle: first meeting, multi-stakeholder qualification, technical deep dives, pilots, steering committees, procurement, and close.
Build pipeline too. Most of our pipeline is partnership-led today and we do less outbound than we'd like, simply because we don't yet have the capacity, so the new logos you open add straight to your number.
Stay after signature. Work with our Deployment Strategists to drive adoption, get onsite when it counts, and grow one deal into a multi-year partnership. We don't hand accounts off; you own them end-to-end and pull in deployment support where you need it.
Build the engine: the sales motions, playbooks, and tooling that let us serve more customers without scaling headcount one-for-one, and feed what you hear from customers straight back into product.
Who we hire
This is an entrepreneurial role: there is no finished playbook, and you'll build as much as you run. You'll fit right in if your former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest operators they've ever worked with.

You've sold technical products and are curious enough to go deep on a hard space. No SAP or ERP background needed, but within a few weeks you can hold your own in a conversation with an enterprise IT team.
You own accounts beyond the close , growing them into bigger relationships rather than just landing logos.
Strong communication , storytelling, and executive presence. You can run a room.

The Senior Account Manager, Digital Investment role is part of the Media.Monks Digital Investment team. The Digital Investment team develops and executes digital media strategies across programmatic and direct media channels, including CTV, display, video, digital audio, native, and other emerging formats.

The Senior Account Manager is responsible for the day-to-day planning, setup, trafficking, pacing, monitoring, optimization, and measurement of digital media campaigns across multiple buying platforms.

This role serves as a client-facing media lead across a portfolio of accounts and works closely with account, media strategy, paid social, paid search, creative, analytics, and operations partners to ensure campaigns are delivered accurately, efficiently, and in line with client goals and processes.

Serve as the client-facing Digital Investment lead on account teams, partnering closely with media strategy, paid search, and paid social leads.
Develop and recommend digital media plans across programmatic and direct partners based on client objectives, audience, budget, and KPIs.
Set up, launch, and manage programmatic campaigns across a variety of DSPs, ensuring accurate campaign structure, targeting, budgets, and tracking.
Research, evaluate, and recommend direct media partners and publishers that align with client objectives and audience strategy.
Manage the RFP, negotiation, launch, in-flight management, and post-campaign process for direct media partnerships.
Coordinate with ad operations on trafficking in DCM and support tracking, Floodlight, creative, and measurement setup for new and existing advertisers.
Own in-flight pacing, budget management, QA, optimization, and performance monitoring across assigned campaigns, escalating risks and recommending corrective actions.
Troubleshoot trafficking, creative, publisher, and platform issues; coordinate with internal teams and third-party vendors as needed. Build clear reporting and provide data-driven recommendations to improve campaign performance.
Measure campaign impact and effectiveness using relevant quantitative and qualitative metrics, translating performance into clear insights and recommendations for account leads and clients.
Provide subject matter expertise across programmatic platforms and digital media channels, helping teams apply best practices in campaign execution and optimization.
Stay current on media platforms, industry trends, measurement approaches, and emerging technologies, and identify opportunities to improve campaign performance and team capabilities.

3+ years of experience in programmatic and/or digital media management, including hands-on campaign execution.
Strong understanding of digital media planning, campaign activation, optimization, pacing, and measurement.
Experience working with at least one of the following: DV360, The Trade Desk and Amazon DSP.
Experience working with or familiarity with DCM and digital ad serving and tracking concepts.
Experience with one or more digital media channels such as CTV/OTT, digital audio, native, high-impact, video, or direct publisher buys.
Experience presenting digital media performance, insights, and strategy in a client-facing setting.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to campaign QA, troubleshooting, and delivery against deadlines.
